- [`c4h_collapse`](clim4health-reference/c4h_collapse.Rd.qmd): Collapse one dimension of the  s2dv_cube .

- [`c4h_convert`](clim4health-reference/c4h_convert.Rd.qmd): Convert  s2dv_cube  objects to  terra ,  stars ,  data.

- [`c4h_convert_units`](clim4health-reference/c4h_convert_units.Rd.qmd): Convert the units of a variable or variables in an s2dv_cube.

- [`c4h_data`](clim4health-reference/c4h_data.Rd.qmd): These datasets are stored in  inst/extdata/  and are accessed
 through functions such as  c4h_load  or via
 system.

- [`c4h_downscale`](clim4health-reference/c4h_downscale.Rd.qmd): Downscale and calibrate climate data.

- [`c4h_get`](clim4health-reference/c4h_get.Rd.qmd): Download netCDF climate data from the Copernicus Climate Data Store.

- [`c4h_get_help`](clim4health-reference/c4h_get_help.Rd.qmd): Displays a list of available climate datasets that can downloaded from
 the Copernicus Climate Data Store using  c4h_get , as well as
 information about the available variables and parameters.

- [`c4h_index`](clim4health-reference/c4h_index.Rd.qmd): Apply a threshold-based mask to climate data based on value ranges.

- [`c4h_load`](clim4health-reference/c4h_load.Rd.qmd): Load forecast, hindcast, or observational climate data (reanalysis or
 stations) as an  s2dv_cube  object.

- [`c4h_plot`](clim4health-reference/c4h_plot.Rd.qmd): Plots  s2dv_cube  gridded, polygon and point climate data
 generated by  clim4health  functions.

- [`c4h_plotskill`](clim4health-reference/c4h_plotskill.Rd.qmd): Plots  s2dv_cube  verification skill scores for gridded,
 polygon and point data generated by  c4h_verify .

- [`c4h_save`](clim4health-reference/c4h_save.Rd.qmd): Save  s2dv_cube  objects used in  clim4health  functions to disk.

- [`c4h_space`](clim4health-reference/c4h_space.Rd.qmd): Performs a spatial aggregation of gridded climate data into areas.

- [`c4h_time`](clim4health-reference/c4h_time.Rd.qmd): Performs a temporal aggregation of climate data from a finer to a coarser
 time scale.

- [`c4h_verify`](clim4health-reference/c4h_verify.Rd.qmd): Computes quality assessment metrics of climate forecasts.

- [`clim4health-package`](clim4health-reference/clim4health-package.Rd.qmd): Obtain, transform and export climate data including reanalyses, (seasonal) forecasts and hindcasts, and weather stations for their use in epidemiological analyses.
